patterns.note: Alternating light and dark full-width sections create clear visual breaks and content hierarchy down the page.
A single sans-serif typeface is used across the site, with large, bold headings for impact and smaller, legible body text. Key words in headings are highlighted with a vibrant accent color.
A professional dark teal/green is paired with a bright mint green accent, providing a fresh and modern feel against a clean white and light grey background.
The primary navigation bar transforms upon scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid background to remain sticky at the top of the viewport.
Content sections, such as the statistics and testimonial carousel, reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the user's viewport during scrolling.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header that dynamically reduces its height and applies a solid background color after the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Utilize scroll-triggered animations to progressively reveal content sections as they enter the viewport, employing a gentle fade-in or slide-up effect for each block.
Integrate a full-width background video in the hero section, playing silently on loop, to add dynamic visual interest without distracting from the primary call to action.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (hero ~3x body) with a clear hierarchy, complemented by smaller uppercase labels for categorization.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are consistently applied to buttons, input fields, and card-like elements, creating a soft and approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing with generous vertical separation between major sections, ensuring good readability and a clean layout without feeling overly dense or airy.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a vibrant mint green as a key accent color, particularly in the hero headline, immediately sets it apart from typical corporate designs. This color choice, combined with subtle background gradients and a clean layout, gives the site a fresh, modern, and approachable yet professional character.
